measurement: Ask accuracy baseline on DBpedia 2022.12.01 for Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5
host: A development laptop with 16 cores and 30 GB of memory that was running other work, with load averages between 10 and 40. Wall times in this record come from that loaded host and are context, not latency measurements.
scope: QALD-9-plus with 107 retained questions and Text2SPARQL'25 db25 with 74 retained questions. Haiku ran QALD three times, Sonnet twice and Opus once, and each model ran db25 once where the cap allowed. The QALD questions were used while Ask grounding was tuned, so they are regression evidence. db25 was not used in that tuning.

methodology.secondaryScoringPolicy: equal width, which is rdf-term-set-global-columns-v1 and gives no credit to an answer with extra columns
methodology.recomputation: Every count is recomputed from the per-case files and checked against the report rows.
methodology.noiseFloor: For two runs on the same questions, d is the per-question difference of correctness and the half-width is 1.96 times the standard deviation of d over the square root of the question count.
methodology.taxonomy: A script classifies every wrong answer from the saved prompts, queries and results, and question-level overrides record gold that is broken on this release. The categories are (a) the needed predicate or class was missing from every prompt, (b) wrong or unlinked resource, (c) clarification policy, (d) wrong query shape or reasoning, including a refusal when the needed terms were in context, (e) a right answer that the scorer marks wrong, (f) gold that is wrong or broken on this release and (g) provider error or truncation.

budget.ledger: fresh ledger for this campaign, carryover fresh-authorization-20261031 of 0
budget.interruptions: The kernel ran out of memory on generated queries at about 22:49Z, 00:47Z and 01:42Z and stopped the session that held the runner. Each interrupted attempt is kept, its spend counted, and the run restarted in a fresh directory on the same ledger. The last Opus blocks ran in a scope capped at 12 GB.

projectionAudit.note: Synthetic answers with competing guesses in separate columns, eight columns or repeated rows all pass the projected policy. A guard that caps extra columns at three and reports passes whose extra column holds predicates or whose projection drops rows would flag 26 measured passes.
